# Suraj Laddagiri

> Suraj Laddagiri is a software engineer and a senior at UC San Diego (graduating
> September 2026), with degrees in Mathematics–Computer Science, Bioengineering,
> and Political Science. He builds iOS apps, embedded and Bluetooth hardware, and
> machine-learning projects, and he is a certified EMT.

This is his personal portfolio site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/): overview and short bio.
- [Work](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/portfolio): all projects.
- [HAVEN](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/haven): a head-mounted navigation aid for blind and low-vision users. iOS app, Core Bluetooth, LiDAR, and five haptic motors, all on-device. Software lead.
- [Music Strip](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/musicstrip): a Bluetooth-controlled LED strip. WS2812B LEDs on an ESP32, controlled by an iOS app with music-reactive modes and album-art colors.
- [Congressional Vote Prediction](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/congress): a machine-learning model that predicts how each of the 535 members of Congress votes on a bill, using DistilBERT embeddings and one network per member. 86.4% mean accuracy.
- [IGAdBlock](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/igadblock): an iOS tweak that removes ads from Instagram's feed by hooking its data sources at runtime, found through reverse engineering with FLEX.
- [SLEAP iOS](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/sleap-ios): on-device animal pose estimation on iPhone and iPad. A SLEAP-NN model (two-stage top-down U-Net, 13 keypoints per fly) runs through ONNX Runtime with Core ML acceleration at up to 17 FPS.
- [ScrollParty](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/scrollparty): an experimental iOS tweak for watching Instagram Reels in sync on two phones. Detection of scrolling, playback, 2x and comments works; rebuilding one account's feed on another phone is in progress.
- [sladdagiri.org](https://portfolio.sladdagiri.org/website): how this site is built (source: https://github.com/surajladdagiri/sladdagiri.org). React 19, hand-written Three.js, and Cloudflare Workers with D1, R2, and Durable Objects.
